content.short: Cookie3 provides Web3 marketing intelligence tools that combine analytics, attribution, and AI driven audience understanding.
content.description: Cookie3 is a marketing analytics product built for Web3 teams that want clearer visibility into users, campaigns, and onchain behavior. Its official positioning centers on marketing intelligence, attribution, and AI assisted analysis that helps brands understand wallet activity, campaign quality, and growth efficiency across Web3 channels. Rather than acting as an end-user app, Cookie3 serves project operators who need better data to allocate spend, design rewards, and understand performance. On Mantle, it fits as analytics infrastructure for teams scaling growth with verifiable onchain and offchain signals.
